notes: BIRTHPLACE FLAGGED AS UNSUPPORTED (research 2026-07-03): every other person/event in the documented compiled genealogy for this family (theblacketts.com/node/34) sits on the Thames in London — Stepney, Southwark, Bethnal Green, Rotherhithe, Limehouse. No source connects this family to Ravensworth, Yorkshire or to any Yorkshire Blackett gentry line; theblacketts.com gives no date for this man beyond 'father of William, b. 1750' and never uses 'Ravensworth.' Two unrelated real 'prestige' Blackett lines exist that could account for a spurious graft (the Blackett Baronets of Newby Hall, Yorkshire, and the Whickham/Lamesley Blacketts of Gateshead, Co. Durham) — even that site's own researchers say the North-East branches' interconnections are themselves 'not established.' Treat as unsupported pending a primary parish-register check.
